name: polymarket-mcp
description: Public Polymarket discovery, exact CLOB V2 books, realtime research, replay, simulation, and opt-in trading.
long_description: A self-contained Rust MCP server for Polymarket. The default research profile requires no credentials and hides every authenticated trading tool. Exact financial values and 256-bit IDs are returned as strings. Optional trading uses a separate profile plus explicit enablement and confirmations.

tool_profile.title: Tool profile
tool_profile.description: research (recommended), core, trading, or all. Trading order mutations still require separate environment configuration.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Search active Polymarket events and markets.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Get an enriched market and current outcome books.

tools.name: scan_market_microstructure
tools.description: Scan active markets for exact-decimal L2 metrics.

tools.name: watch_markets
tools.description: Maintain local realtime order books over WebSocket.

tools.name: simulate_order
tools.description: Estimate fills and slippage without placing an order.
